title: Greywater Bay Rising Anew
author: Freya Sandoval
blurb: Sable Coldharbour, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
